description: Armor and gear, weapons, magic items (potions, pills, scrolls, wands, staves) or pets from the game world, with their stats, who may use them and the zone and mob they come from: the same data as https://dreamland.rocks/searcher.html. Only items placed in the world by zone resets are listed. Sorted by level, or by one bonus, highest first.

align.description: Only items restricted to these alignments; unrestricted items match none.

include_limited.description: false drops items the world holds only a few of.

lang.description: Answer language: en, ru or ua (uk also accepted). Untranslated text falls back to Russian.

query.description: Part of the name in any language; for magic also a spell name, for pets also a trick.

slot.description: armor: any of these wear slots.

sort.description: level (lowest first), damage (weapon average), or a bonus, highest first.

stats.description: armor/weapon: must give every one of these bonuses (hr = hit, dr = damage).

type.description: armor (all wearable gear), weapon, magic or pet.

name: item_search
title: Search DreamLand items
